author: National Geographic
description:
Travel across the United States with Michael B. Jordan to witness never-before-seen footage of the unique animals that call America's distinct landscapes home. From the Grand Canyon, to Denali, North America's highest peak, to the wild, wild west, creatures make and protect their homes. This America the Beautiful MEGA Episode features three, full episodes: 

Land of Heroes - 00:00 
Never-before-seen stories of heroic animals — both endearing and downright bizarre — play out against a breath-taking backdrop of America’s most iconic landscapes. Aerial cameras take viewers on a thrilling journey from the ice caps to the desert, from sea to shining sea. Whether mountain lions in the Grand Canyon or prairie dogs battling a tornado, find out what it takes to be an American hero.
